title: ZS's Features
description: A vanilla+ mod to enhance your overall experience, featuring new Biomes and mechanics!
body:
Adds the following to enhance your vanilla experience while also adding new functions alongside it.
Please be aware that this is still in **_Early Access_**, please feel free to report any bugs or improvement ideas in the discord server.

## Biome Changes
### The Desert
- Adds a new "Plague" effect whenever you enter the Desert. Acts similarly to the Poison effect but more deadly.
- New types of Trees(Palm Trees)
- New Ores, one naturally generates and the other is a Skeleton drop(only inside the Desert)

### "Cold" Biomes
- Adds a new "Frostbite" effect whenever you enter any "cold" biome, this includes the following Biomes(Snowy Plains, Snowy Beach, Ice Spikes, etc..). Acts similarly to the Plague effect
- New naturally generated materials(Ice Spikes)
- New small structure
- New Potions(Potion of Warmth)
- The "Warmth" effect protects you temporarily from the Frostbite effect. Either right click a campfire or craft a Frost Medallion to obtain this effect.

### Lush Caves
- Adds a new "Axolotl Blessing" effect which gives beneficial effects(only if you have the Lush Medallion).

### Forsaken Caves
- Naturally generates underground(very common Biome)
- New Ores
- New Cave Plants

### The Hollow
- Naturally generates in the Nether
- New Blocks
- New Nether Plants
- Acts as a "safe" biome while in the Nether
